_comment: Licence allow-list for `./gradlew checkLicense --no-configuration-cache`.
Policy and reasoning: docs/LEGAL.md §9.2.
SCOPE — runtime dependencies only, i.e. what actually ships. Build-tool and test classpaths
are excluded via `licenseReport.configurations` in the root build: nothing on them reaches a
user, so their licences carry no distribution obligation for us.
NAMES — these are the *normalised* names produced by LicenseBundleNormalizer, not raw POM
strings. They are deliberately verbatim: 'The 2-Clause BSD License', not 'BSD-2-Clause'. If a
new dependency fails the check with a licence that is clearly acceptable, check whether it is
the same licence under a name the normaliser has not folded in before adding an entry.
TO ADD AN ENTRY — it must be permissive, or weak copyleft used as an unmodified library.
Strong copyleft (GPL without the Classpath Exception), network copyleft (AGPL) and
source-available licences (SSPL, BUSL, Elastic-2.0) are NOT acceptable: this project ships a
public network service whose own source is Apache-2.0. The matching deny-list for new
dependencies at PR time lives in .github/workflows/dependency-review.yml.
DELIBERATELY ABSENT — 'GNU LESSER GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE, Version 2.1'. Logback is the only
dependency offering it, and it is dual-licensed, so it passes on EPL-2.0 instead. Keeping LGPL
off the list means an LGPL-only dependency stops the build and gets a decision, which is the
intent. Same for CC0 ('Creative Commons Legal Code'): HdrHistogram passes on 2-Clause BSD.
ANTLR — 'The BSD License' (org.antlr:ST4) and 'BSD licence' (org.antlr:antlr-runtime) are the
raw POM spellings, which LicenseBundleNormalizer does not fold in. Both are BSD-3-Clause:
antlr.org/license.html carries all three clauses including the endorsement one. They reach us
through Spring AI's StringTemplate dependency (#470). These two are the exception to the
normalised-names rule above, and they are named per module rather than globally so that a
different dependency claiming 'The BSD License' still stops the build and gets read.

allowedLicenses.moduleLicense: GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE, Version 2 + Classpath Exception
